summary: Iteration 75 — full verification of three HR Admin changes: (1) Break Time column + segregated breaks popup on the Attendance table, (2) Month/Year selectors on Create Payslip modal, (3) Generate Payslip opens the same modal pre-filled from a new /api/hr/admin/payslip/preview endpoint with all fields editable + Refresh-attendance to re-pull a different period. All 4 backend pytest cases pass; all 7 UI flow checks pass.
critical_code_review_comments: hr_routes.preview_payslip computes net_salary = per_day * min(effective_days, total_working_days) which silently caps extra_days when it would push total over the calendar's working_days. Confirm this is intentional — generate_payslip should follow the same rule so both pathways stay in sync.

PayrollManagementTab.js — refresh-attendance button only renders for manualSource === 'generate'. If HR opens 'Create Payslip — Manual' then later wants to populate from attendance, they have to close & re-open via Generate. Consider always showing Refresh once a Period is picked.
Pre-existing: floating-point payroll total (e.g. 25000.04) carried over from iteration 74 — apply round() in either the preview endpoint or the salary-details aggregate.

EnhancedAttendanceTab now passes `record` for every employee; verify the field is omitted from the network payload to keep the list endpoint lean (the attendance object can be sizable for users with many breaks).
seed_data_creation: Created one Lunch break for Vinothkumar Babu on 2026-06-15 via /api/hr/attendance/break-out + /break-in (left in DB; benign — only seeded for popup verification). Created+deleted a single May-2026 manual payslip for user 'Vinothkumar' (user_0ff0a2302849) — fully cleaned up at end of run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend: /api/hr/admin/payslip/preview/{user_id}/{year}/{month} requires Bearer auth via session_token (not access_token in login response — login returns {user, session_token}). Use SUPER_ADMIN.email==vinoth@drawlead.com for tests. UI: HR Admin → Attendance uses EnhancedAttendanceTab; Break Time column renders between 'Worked Hours' and 'Details'. The break-view link only shows when an employee has at least one break for the selected day — create breaks for testing via the BreakOut quick-button or POST /api/hr/attendance/break-out (require prior clock-in). HR Admin → Payroll Mgmt empty-state shows both 'Generate Payslip' (green) and 'Create Payslip' (purple) — click an employee with no payslip (e.g. Vinothkumar / user_0ff0a2302849) to reach this state. Modal testids: payslip-period-month, payslip-period-year, payslip-refresh-attendance (generate-only). Submit button label is 'Create Payslip' (last occurrence inside the dialog).
rca of the issue:
No issues. Verified:
  - GET /api/hr/admin/payslip/preview/{user_id}/2026/6 → 200 with full payload; 2nd call returns identical payload and db.payslips row-count unchanged (idempotent).
  - 401 for anon; 404 for unknown user_id.
  - Attendance: 'Break Time' header present, '-' for employees with 0 breaks. After seeding a Lunch break, link shows '0m (1)', dialog title is 'Break Details — Vinothkumar Babu', card shows Lunch badge + Out 11:09 am + In 11:09 am + Reason 'lunch break'.
  - Generate Payslip modal: title 'Generate Payslip — Review & Edit', period strip with testids payslip-period-month / payslip-period-year, Refresh attendance button. Pre-filled values come from preview endpoint (Working Days=22 for June).
  - Switching month to May (5) and clicking Refresh attendance re-pulls preview — Working Days dropped from 22 to 21 (calendar working days for May).
  - Create Payslip modal: title 'Create Payslip — Manual', period strip present, refresh button hidden (correct — manual mode).
  - End-to-end persistence: parent page on June 2026, modal Period set to May 2026, submitted from purple 'Create Payslip' button → POST /api/hr/admin/payslip/manual created payslip with {month: 5, year: 2026, creation_mode: 'manual'} (verified via /api/hr/admin/payslips?month=5&year=2026).
